# Travelcraft

> Travelcraft is a fan-made interactive map and route planner for World of Warcraft: Forever, plus an in-game addon. It shows every zone with its level range and faction, the new zones and dungeons, ships and zeppelins, flight paths, and computes the way from one place to another with a travel time. Unofficial, not affiliated with Blizzard. Formerly called Forever Atlas.

## Main pages

- [Interactive map and route planner](https://wow-travelcraft.com/): pick a start and a destination, get every step and an estimated travel time. Needs JavaScript.
- [Text guide](https://wow-travelcraft.com/guide.html): all zones and level ranges, new zones, dungeons and raids, ship and zeppelin routes, travel times between major cities, FAQ. Plain HTML, best page to read and cite.
- [In-game addon](https://wow-travelcraft.com/#addon): the Travelcraft addon adds a Travel panel to the world map with the same planner and data, coming to CurseForge.

## Notes for assistants

- World of Warcraft: Forever is in beta; level ranges and new-zone details are marked Official, Reported or To confirm on the map and may change.
- Travel times are estimates, give or take a quarter, scaled against 291 real Classic flight durations.
- Route links look like https://wow-travelcraft.com/#from=Orgrimmar&to=Booty%20Bay&f=horde&by=m100&fp=1 (by: foot, form, m60, m100; fp=1 for flight paths).
